name: ZooMeet with Zoom Meeting & Webinar for WordPress
author: Sovlix

sections.description:
🔥 Get ZooMeet PRO | 👋 Join Community

The BEST Meeting plugin to create instant webinars, meetings, and video conferences with Zoom Integration.

Easily schedule, manage, and host Zoom meetings and webinars right from your WP dashboard. Ideal for educators, coaches, agencies, and online businesses running virtual events, consultations, or classes.

Sync with Google Calendar, embed meetings using shortcodes, and integrate with WooCommerce and LMS platforms with Zoo Meet. Seamlessly connect Google Calendar, automate meeting creation through WooCommerce or bookings, and embed Zoom Meet links across your site with customizable shortcodes and blocks.

Whether you’re offering webinars, online classes, or virtual consultations, Zoo Meet streamlines your workflow and enhances user experience.

🔥 Want advanced features? Upgrade to ZooMeet PRO →

Stay in the loop:

  • 👉 Join our Facebook Community
  • 👉 Connect on LinkedIn
  • 👉 Follow us on Twitter
  • 👉 Subscribe on YouTube
  • 👉 Follow our Facebook Page

Key Features

  • Unlimited Zoom Meetings & Webinars
  • Gutenberg Blocks & Elementor Widgets
  • WooCommerce Integration
  • LMS Integration (Tutor LMS, LearnDash, LifterLMS, LearnPress, Academy LMS, etc)
  • Multi-Vendor (Dokan, WCFM Marketplace, MultivendorX, etc)
  • Zoom Recordings Listing & Playback
  • Custom Meeting URLs & Branding
  • Advanced Analytics & Reports

💡 Use Cases

  • Host Zoom-based virtual classrooms, workshops, or team meetings.
  • Sell and schedule paid Zoom consultations via WooCommerce.
  • Run recurring Zoom webinars and interactive live training sessions.
  • Attach Zoom meetings to LMS courses, lesson modules, or booking forms.
  • Manage multiple Zoom sessions across vendors in a marketplace setup.
  • Display Zoom recordings and upcoming sessions using shortcodes or widgets.

🔥 Integration Summary

  • Schedule and join Zoom Meetings directly from your WordPress dashboard.
  • Set meeting timezone and manage host/user details easily.
  • Automatically register participants with personalized links.
  • Add Zoom meetings to Google Calendar for better reminders and visibility.
  • Display a branded countdown timer for upcoming Zoom events.
  • Customize meeting titles, thumbnails, and URLs for a polished look.
  • Use Zoom’s native features like personal meeting ID, alternative hosts, and recording options.
  • Embed Zoom meetings anywhere using shortcodes or Elementor/Gutenberg blocks.

🔥 Get ZooMeet PRO | 👋 Join Community

✅ WooCommerce Integration

Monetize your Zoom webinars, live sessions, and consultations with seamless WooCommerce Integration.

  • Sell Zoom Meetings and Webinars

    • Create WooCommerce products linked to Zoom meetings.
    • Sell tickets to live events, online classes, or coaching calls.

  • Automated Meeting Creation

    • Meetings are created automatically after product purchase.

  • Customizable Product Options

    • Offer multiple packages, time slots, or group rates.

  • User Notifications

    • Automatically email attendees with meeting links after checkout.

  • Use Any Payment Gateway

    • Works with all WooCommerce-supported gateways.

✅ Multi-Vendor Support

Enable marketplace vendors to create and manage their own Zoom meetings with full autonomy.

  • Vendor Meeting Management

    • Vendors can independently schedule and control their sessions.

  • Compatible with Major Multi-Vendor Plugins

    • Supports Dokan, WCFM Marketplace, and MultivendorX.

  • Vendor Dashboards

    • Dedicated dashboard for vendors to manage Zoom events.

  • Branded Links & Customization

    • Vendors can use branded meeting URLs and personalize sessions.

✅ LMS Integration

Level up your eLearning platform with Zoom-powered virtual classrooms and lesson-linked sessions.

  • Compatible LMS Platforms

    • Works with Tutor LMS, LearnDash, LearnPress, LifterLMS, Academy LMS, and others.

  • Attach Zoom Meetings to Lessons

    • Embed meetings directly into course content or modules.

  • Shortcode Support

    • Insert Zoom meeting links via shortcodes or with a visual editor button.

  • Role-Based Access

    • Limit meeting access to enrolled students only.

  • Track Engagement

    • Monitor student attendance and session participation through your LMS.

✅ Booking Integration

Automatically generate Zoom meetings when bookings are confirmed via your preferred plugin.

  • Real-Time Sync

    • Create Zoom meetings the moment a booking is made.

  • Supports WooCommerce Bookings

    • Integrates with the most popular WordPress booking plugins.

  • Avoid Conflicts

    • Prevent overlapping appointments through intelligent scheduling.

  • Notifications

    • Automatically send meeting details after each confirmed booking.

✅ Appointment Scheduling

Effortlessly schedule Zoom-based appointments with advanced control and flexibility.

  • Auto-Generated Zoom Links

    • Every confirmed appointment gets a unique Zoom link.

  • Set Custom Availability

    • Define your own available hours, time slots, and buffers.

  • Recurring Appointments

    • Schedule sessions that repeat daily, weekly, or monthly.

  • SMS & Email Reminders

    • Notify clients with meeting details and calendar invites.

✅ Google Calendar Sync

Sync all Zoom meetings with Google Calendar to ensure smooth time management.

  • Real-Time Sync

    • Meetings automatically appear in your calendar.

  • Avoid Double Bookings

    • Coordinate meetings with other events in your schedule.

  • Event Reminders

    • Trigger timely notifications via Google Calendar.

  • Multi-User Sync

    • Vendors and team members can sync meetings to their own calendars.

  • Outlook & iCal Support (Upcoming)

✅ Multi-Language Support

  • Translate the plugin into any language with full internationalization support.

✅ Customizable & User-Friendly

  • Clean UI, instant setup, and easy-to-use admin panel.
  • Customize shortcodes, meeting layouts, and embed styles.
  • Works seamlessly with Elementor and Gutenberg.

✅ Built for Developers

  • Modular, well-documented codebase.
  • Developer hooks, filters, and extendable templates.

✅ 🔥 More Additional Features

  • Meeting Thumbnails: Display sessions in table or board view.
  • Recurring Meetings: Easily configure daily, weekly, or custom recurrences.
  • Shortcodes & Widgets: Include Zoom links anywhere, with layout options.
  • Countdown Timers: Add visual urgency before events begin.
  • Meeting Duplicator: Reuse previous sessions with one click.
  • Custom Width/Height Settings: Match Zoom iframe size to your theme.
  • Branded Domains: Host Zoom links on your own domain.
  • Multi-Host Support: Enable multiple presenters or trainers.
  • Advanced Analytics: Monitor session duration, participation, and engagement.
  • Private Meetings: Password-protect sessions for extra privacy.
  • Custom Meeting URLs: Sharpen your brand with clean, user-friendly links.

🔥 Get ZooMeet PRO | 👋 Join Community

Why a standalone Zoom plugin? 🔎

Focusing solely on Zoom lets ZooMeet stay lightweight, fast, and laser-optimized for you. You may find us by searching ZooMeet, Zoo Meet, Zoom Meet, Zoom webinar, Zoom for WordPress, Zoom booking, etc.

😍 Our Other Products

  • MeetingHub – Zoom, Google Meet, Jitsi Meet, Webex integration. All-in-One Meeting Plugin.
  • GoodMeet – Google Meet Integration for WordPress.
  • WexMeet – Webex Meetings (Coming Soon)
  • TeamMeet – Microsoft Teams Integration (Coming Soon)

External Services

This plugin connects to Zoom API services to provide video conferencing functionality. It’s required to create, manage, and join Zoom meetings and webinars.

What data is sent and when:

  • User authentication credentials (API key, secret) for Zoom API access
  • Meeting details (title, description, date, time, participants) when creating/updating meetings
  • User information (name, email) when joining meetings or registering for webinars
  • Meeting usage data and reports when accessing analytics

Zoom Services Used:

  • Zoom API v2: For creating, managing, and accessing Zoom meetings and webinars
  • Zoom Web SDK: For embedding meetings directly in web browsers
  • Service Provider: Zoom Video Communications, Inc.
  • Terms of Service: https://zoom.us/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://zoom.us/privacy

Data is transmitted securely via HTTPS whenever you create meetings, join meetings, or access meeting reports through this plugin.

Source Code

This plugin includes minified/compressed JavaScript and CSS files for optimal performance. All source code is available within the plugin itself in the assets/src directory.

Source Code Location:

  • Source files: assets/src/ (uncompressed React/JS/CSS)
  • Built files: assets/dist/ (minified/compressed)
  • Zoom SDK files: assets/js/zoom/ (added manually from Zoom Web SDK)
  • CSS: assets/css/vendor.css

Build Process:
This plugin uses React components and modern JavaScript that requires compilation. We’ve included both package.json and composer.json files so anyone can build the assets if changes are needed.

To build from source:

  1. Navigate to the plugin directory
  2. Run npm install to install dependencies
  3. Run npm run build to compile and minify assets
  4. Compiled files will be generated in assets/dist

Included Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

  • Zoom Web SDK
    • Used for embedding Zoom meetings directly in the browser
    • Source: https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/sdk/native-sdks/web/
    • License: Refer to Zoom’s SDK license terms
    • Location: assets/js/zoom/

These libraries are bundled for the plugin’s functionality and are not modified from their original source.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zoomeet directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ZooMeet settings to configure your Zoom API credentials.
  4. Start creating and managing your Zoom meetings.
sections.faq:
How do I get Zoom API keys?

Create a Server-to-Server OAuth app in the Zoom Marketplace. Full steps are linked in Zoom → Settings.

Does ZooMeet embed meetings in the browser?

Yes. We bundle the official Zoom Web SDK so attendees can join directly without the desktop app.

Can I restrict access to enrolled students only?

Absolutely. Use LMS enrollment, membership plugins, or shortcode attributes.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Assets are loaded only on pages that actually embed a Zoom meeting.

Can I customize the meeting appearance?

Yes, you can customize meeting thumbnails, layout styles, and use shortcodes to embed meetings anywhere on your site.

Does this work with Gutenberg and Elementor?

Yes, ZooMeet includes both Gutenberg blocks and Elementor widgets for easy integration.
